title: Pinnacle Food Group Limited Achieves Laboratory-Scale Astaxanthin Extraction in Haematococcus pluvialis Program
summary: Pinnacle Food Inc., based in Vancouver, BC, Canada, is a revolutionary company in the world of agriculture that is making vertical farming and hydroponics easy and accessible to everyone.
body_markdown:
*Topic: ***** Company Update


**Research workflow advances from strain screening and three-stage culture expansion through stress induction, astaxanthin accumulation and extraction at laboratory scale**


**VANCOUVER, BC / November 17, 2026 /** Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) ("Pinnacle Food" or the "Company"), a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of smart farming and bioengineering, today announced that its Canadian subsidiary, Pinnacle Food Inc., has, through in-house research at its Vancouver laboratory, successfully achieved astaxanthin extraction at laboratory scale in its Haematococcus pluvialis microalgae research program.


The program's research workflow has now progressed through algal strain screening, three-stage culture expansion, stress induction and astaxanthin accumulation, and extraction of astaxanthin from the cultivated biomass. Cultivation was carried out using a 500-liter photobioreactor, followed by laboratory-scale astaxanthin extraction using an in-house extraction process. The Company considers this an early-stage milestone in its research and development process.


Astaxanthin is a naturally occurring carotenoid, and Haematococcus pluvialis is a microalga widely studied as a natural source of astaxanthin. The Company intends to continue research toward process optimization and evaluation of scale-up feasibility. The results to date are at laboratory scale, and further work is required before any assessment of commercial viability can be made. There can be no assurance that the Company's research will result in a commercially viable process or product.


"We are encouraged that our team has completed the laboratory workflow from strain screening through astaxanthin extraction," said Mr. Jiulong You, Chief Executive Officer of Pinnacle Food. "This is an early-stage research milestone. We will remain disciplined as we continue to evaluate process optimization and scale-up feasibility as part of our microalgae biomanufacturing research."


**About Pinnacle Food Group Limited**


Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) is a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of smart farming and bioengineering. Through its "Dual-Engine" strategy, the Company seeks to combine controlled-environment agricultural technologies with precision fermentation, synthetic biology and related engineering capabilities to support the development and commercialization of high-value biological products. For more information, please visit the Company's website at[www.pinnaclefoodinc.com](https://pr.report/tn2c) .
